name: Algolaser Alpha MK2 20W
tagline: 20W Premium open-frame diode focused on speed and fine engraving detail
tldr: Algolaser Alpha MK2 20W is the 20W SKU on the Algolaser algolaser alpha mk2 line. Algolaser targets makers who want faster engraving and tighter spot control than typical budget diodes. Verify optical power on the listing : do not assume combined-watt marketing.
mainObjective: Everyday engraving plus reliable light cutting on wood, leather, and dark acrylic

priceRange.note: 20W optical module : verify SKU before buying

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: 20W Premium open-frame diode focused on speed and fine engraving detail
Open-frame layout : laser glasses and ventilation are your responsibility
Work area 440 × 410 mm on this chassis
Balanced engrave and cut : typical 8 mm basswood in multiple passes
Reference engrave job on this module: ~9–14 min
Reference cut job on this module: ~5–9 min
cons: Higher modules in this line (40W) add cut speed and depth
Verify the 20W SKU : same chassis, different modules
Open frame: kids, pets, and smoke are not contained
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 20W module on Algolaser Alpha MK2. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Use air assist for cuts, lower scan speed for photo engraving. Multiple passes at moderate speed beat one aggressive pass. Check the flagship tier’s cut benchmark if you quote production times to customers.
